scope: isolated measurement-v2 prototype, regression fixtures and bounded replay; not connected to production

alternatives.wrapOldIdAliases: rejected: rating and source time are already lost before confirmation
alternatives.editProductionDirectly: rejected for this stage: cannot establish isolated regression evidence first
alternatives.separateResearchModule: selected: explicit quotes and composite identity; reuse existing time/retention constants and preserve legacy archive

identity: platform+rating+profileId+exactName; no ID-only or name-only fallback; exact edition ambiguity remains
quoteTime: explicit source observation time, never generated from a new processing cycle for cached data
momentum: reject current legacy momentum without explicit platform/rating/name/time; permit only an explicitly enriched matching quote; report coverage loss
confirmation: two distinct increasing source times, >=60s after candidate creation and >=60s apart, same identity, each price >= frozen target; one quote cannot be reused
continuity: missing/invalid identity observation resets pending target chain; repeated identical source quote does not count or renew last-seen; next distinct confirmation gap <= existing MAX_ODSTEP_TRWALOSCI=600s
continuityRationale: conservative explicit measurement policy reusing existing candidate continuity constant, not empirically tuned or a recommendation filter; alternative LUKA=7200 only remains absence closure threshold
freshness: 0 <= processTime-observedAt <= existing SWIEZOSC=600s; frozen 24h event horizon and 2h no-view closure remain
ema: matching full identity and EMA version, nonfuture source time, age <= existing MAX_PRZERWA_EMA_DOBOWA, no change to frozen initial target
history: version2 signature; old closed and open rows copied unchanged to frozen legacy compartment and never counted as v2 evidence; no historical relabeling
stats: conditional candidate target-contact statistic, arithmetic even-n median, explicit closed/unknown counts and scenario bounds; never execution success
checks: valid target confirmations and below-target reset
missing cycle and maximum continuity gap
legacy preservation and no mixed definitions
real-data replay only as format/observability test
exclusions: claiming efficacy from sparse historical replay
